our_interpretation: The plain reading is that AI stocks have suffered comparable percentage declines in less time than technology stocks during the dot-com crash.
The title supplies an approximate five-month observation window ending on the post date. June 20 is a window boundary, not an asserted market peak.
A fair test requires a representative AI basket with disclosed constituents and weights, compared with the Nasdaq Composite after its March 2000 peak over matched elapsed periods.
Individual stocks' losses from different peaks cannot establish the speed of a common basket's decline.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable price histories show that a representative AI basket reached comparable drawdowns in less elapsed time than the dot-com benchmark, with the conclusion robust to reasonable basket choices.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable price histories show that the AI basket declined no faster than the dot-com benchmark over matched elapsed periods, with the conclusion robust to reasonable basket choices.
